name: HZ_ACCOUNT_ROLLUPS
description: The HZ_ACCOUNT_ROLLUPS table stores information Rollup Metrics data.

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_PROFILE_ID
columns.description: An identifier for the organization profiles used as a foreign key to the HZ_ORGANIZATION_PROFILES table.

columns.name: HIER_CURR_FY_POTENTIAL_REVENUE
columns.description: The cumulative total of all of the current fiscal year's potential revenue within an account hierarchy.

columns.name: HIER_EMPLOYEES_TOTAL
columns.description: The count of employees, based on the account number of the employees for each account hierarchy.

columns.name: OPEN_OPTY_REVENUE_AMT
columns.description: The cumulative total of open opportunity potential revenue amount for the account.

columns.name: HIER_OPEN_OPTY_REVENUE_AMT
columns.description: The cumulative total of open opportunity potential revenue amount within the account hierarchy.

columns.name: WON_OPTY_REVENUE_AMT
columns.description: The cumulative total of won opportunity potential revenue amount for the account.

columns.name: HIER_WON_OPTY_REVENUE_AMT
columns.description: The cumulative total of potential revenue amount from won opportunities, within the account hierarchy.

columns.name: NUM_OF_OPEN_OPTY
columns.description: The count of open opportunities within an account.

columns.name: HIER_NUM_OF_OPEN_OPTY
columns.description: Count of opportunities that are open within an account hierarchy.

columns.name: OPEN_ORDER_AMT
columns.description: Cumulative total of quote and order amount for the account where status is Open or Processing.

columns.name: HIER_OPEN_ORDER_AMT
columns.description: Cumulative total of quote and order amount within the account hierarchy, where status is Open or Processing.

columns.name: WON_ORDER_AMT
columns.description: The cumulative total of the order amount for the account where status is Closed.

columns.name: HIER_WON_ORDER_AMT
columns.description: Total of orders within an account hierarchy, where the status is Closed.

columns.name: NUM_OF_OPEN_SR
columns.description: The number of open service requests for the account.

columns.name: HIER_NUM_OF_OPEN_SR
columns.description: The number of open service requests for the account hierarchy.

columns.name: NUM_OF_OPEN_CRITICAL_SR
columns.description: The number of open service requests for the account that have a severity equal to one.

columns.name: HIER_NUM_OF_OPEN_CRITICAL_SR
columns.description: The number of open service requests within an account hierarchy, where the severity is one.

columns.name: NUM_OF_OPEN_LEAD
columns.description: Count of leads that are open on the account.

columns.name: HIER_NUM_OF_OPEN_LEAD
columns.description: Count of leads that are in Open status within an account hierarchy.

columns.name: NUM_OF_OPEN_HOT_LEAD
columns.description: Count of leads that are open and are ranked Hot.

columns.name: HIER_NUM_OF_OPEN_HOT_LEAD
columns.description: Count of leads that are open and are ranked Hot within an account hierarchy.

columns.name: NUM_OF_OPEN_ACTY
columns.description: Count of activities that are open within an account.

columns.name: HIER_NUM_OF_OPEN_ACTY
columns.description: Count of activities that are open within an account hierarchy.

columns.name: NUM_OF_CALL_MADE
columns.description: Number of calls made to an account.

columns.name: HIER_NUM_OF_CALL_MADE
columns.description: Number of calls made to an account and its hierarchy.

columns.name: NUM_OF_EMAIL_SENT
columns.description: Total number of emails sent to an account.

columns.name: HIER_NUM_OF_EMAIL_SENT
columns.description: Total number of emails sent to an account and its hierarchy.

columns.name: LAST_CALL_MADE
columns.description: The date when last call was made to an account.

columns.name: HIER_LAST_CALL_MADE
columns.description: The date when last call was made to an account and its hierarchy.

columns.name: LAST_EMAIL_SENT
columns.description: The date when last email was sent to an account.

columns.name: HIER_LAST_EMAIL_SENT
columns.description: The date when last email was sent to an account and its hierarchy.

columns.name: NUM_OF_TOUCHES
columns.description: Total number of touches with an account. Touches refer to outbound communications such as email, phone and so on.

columns.name: HIER_NUM_OF_TOUCHES
columns.description: Total number of touches with an account and its hierarchy. Touches refer to communications such as email, phone, email, phone and so on.

columns.name: LAST_TOUCH
columns.description: The date when the last touch was made with an account.

columns.name: HIER_LAST_TOUCH
columns.description: The date when the last touch was made with an account and its hierarchy.

columns.name: OPEN_LEAD_DEAL_AMT
columns.description: The sum of the potential revenues from qualified and unqualified open leads of an account.

columns.name: HIER_OPEN_LEAD_DEAL_AMT
columns.description: The sum of the potential revenues from qualified and unqualified open leads of an account and its hierarchy.

columns.name: SUM_OF_ACTIVE_SUBS_MRR
columns.description: The cumulative monthly recurring revenue from active subscription lines on an account.

columns.name: HIER_SUM_OF_ACTIVE_SUBS_MRR
columns.description: The cumulative monthly recurring revenue from active subscription lines on an account and its hierarchy.

columns.name: SUM_OF_ACTIVE_SUBS_TCV
columns.description: The cumulative total contract value amounts from active subscription lines on an account.

columns.name: HIER_SUM_OF_ACTIVE_SUBS_TCV
columns.description: The cumulative total contract value amounts from active subscription lines on an account and its hierarchy.

columns.name: SUM_OF_UPCOMING_RENEW_MRR
columns.description: The cumulative monthly recurring revenue from expiring subscription lines on an account that haven't been amended, closed, suspended, or renewed.

columns.name: HIER_SUM_OF_UPCOMING_RENEW_MRR
columns.description: The cumulative monthly recurring revenue from expiring subscription lines on an account and its hierarchy that haven't been amended, closed, suspended, or renewed.

columns.name: SUM_OF_LAPSED_RENEW_MRR
columns.description: The cumulative monthly recurring revenue from expired subscription lines on an account that don't have renewal lines.

columns.name: HIER_SUM_OF_LAPSED_RENEW_MRR
columns.description: The cumulative monthly recurring revenue from expired subscription lines on an account and its hierarchy that don't have renewal lines.

columns.name: SUM_OF_CLOSED_SUBS_MRR
columns.description: The cumulative monthly recurring revenue from subscription lines on an account that were closed in a given period of time.

columns.name: HIER_SUM_OF_CLOSED_SUBS_MRR
columns.description: The cumulative monthly recurring revenue from subscription lines on an account and its hierarchy that were closed in a given period of time.

columns.name: LAST_COMPLETED_ACTIVITY
columns.description: The date of last completed activity with an account. Activity includes task, appointment, and call report.

columns.name: HIER_LAST_COMPLETED_ACTIVITY
columns.description: The date of last completed activity with an account and its hierarchy. Activity includes task, appointment, and call report.

columns.name: TOTAL_COMPLETED_ACTIVITIES
columns.description: The total number of completed activities with an account.

columns.name: HIER_TOTAL_COMPLETD_ACTIVITIES
columns.description: The total number of completed activities with an account and its hierarchy.

columns.name: NEXT_TASK_DUE
columns.description: The date when a task is due with an account.

columns.name: HIER_NEXT_TASK_DUE
columns.description: The date when a task is due with an account and its hierarchy.

columns.name: TOTAL_NOTES

columns.name: HIER_TOTAL_NOTES
columns.description: The total number of public notes associated with an account and its hierarchy.

columns.name: NUM_ACTIVE_QUOTES

columns.name: HIER_NUM_ACTIVE_QUOTES
columns.description: The total number of active quotes associated with an account and its hierarchy.

columns.name: NUM_ACTIVE_ASSETS

columns.description: The total number of active assets associated with an account and its hierarchy.

columns.name: SUM_ACTIVE_ASSETS

columns.name: HIER_SUM_ACTIVE_ASSETS
columns.description: The cumulative value of assets for an account and its hierarchy.

columns.name: ASSETS_EXP_NXT_QTR

columns.name: HIER_ASSETS_EXP_NXT_QTR
columns.description: The total number of assets going to end of life or expire in the next quarter for an account and its hierarchy.

columns.name: NEXT_APPOINTMENT_DATE
columns.description: The start date and time of the next appointment scheduled for an account.

columns.name: NUM_SUBS_EXP_LAST_QTR
columns.description: The count of subscription products expired in last quarter for an account.

columns.name: HIER_NUM_SUBS_EXP_LAST_QTR
columns.description: The count of subscription products expired in last quarter for an account and its hierarchy.

columns.name: NUM_CONTACTS
columns.description: The number of contacts associated with an account.

columns.name: HIER_NUM_CONTACTS
columns.description: The number of contacts associated with an account and its hierarchy.

columns.name: NUM_OPEN_CR_SR_WAIT_SUPP
columns.description: The total number of open critical service requests that are waiting on support for an account.

columns.name: HIER_NUM_OPEN_CR_SR_WAIT_SUPP
columns.description: The total number of open critical service requests that are waiting on support for an account and its hierarchy.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: The currency code. A list of valid values are defined in the lookup ZCA_COMMON_CORPORATE_CURRENCY. Review and update the profile option using the Setup and Maintenance work area, Manage Currency Profile Options task.

columns.name: CORP_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: The corporate currency code associated with the account. A list of accepted values is defined in the lookup ZCA_COMMON_CORPORATE_CURRENCY. Review and update the profile option using the Setup and Maintenance work area, Manage Trading Community Common Lookups task.

columns.name: CURCY_CONV_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: The currency conversion rate type. This attribute is used by CRM Extensibility framework. A list of valid values are defined in the lookup ZCA_COMMON_RATE_TYPE. Review and update the profile option using the Setup and Maintenance work area, Manage Currency Profile Options task.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).
